hypothesis.claim: The frozen MU 15m breakout, EMA, and depth-10 pressure onset may contain a repeatable long-side forward edge after measured fee and latency friction.

friction_contract.entry: first executable BBO at or after signal publication
friction_contract.exit: first executable BBO at or after the fixed horizon

assessment.diagnosis: Two new long signals were positive at every measured horizon and improved all single-largest-winner sensitivities. The 15m and 60m independent samples remain positive after removing their two largest winners. The 240m sample becomes negative after removing its two largest winners, demonstrating residual winner concentration. All seven onsets are long and occurred in a limited forward window, so this evidence cannot establish a bidirectional or regime-general edge.
assessment.single_highest_value_next_investigation: Continue the exact prospective observer and predeclare a larger independent signal window while building an execution-incapable stop/exit lifecycle replay with exact depth, funding, and source-parity evidence.

proposal_contract.recommendation: Continue MU as the highest-cadence report-only challenger and build lifecycle-quality evidence; do not add MU to the live v51 roster yet.
proposal_contract.why_now: The prospective sample increased from five to seven eligible signals and improved materially after friction, including positive ex-largest results at all horizons.
proposal_contract.evidence_reviewed: Seven prospective journal onsets, 38,724 causal book rows, the frozen development diagnostic, exact current fee evidence, fixed-horizon markouts, overlap filtering, and one- and two-largest-winner sensitivities.
proposal_contract.observed_problem_or_opportunity: MU is producing more source-native eligible observations than the current v51 index routes and its early long markouts are positive, but evidence remains sparse and structurally incomplete.
proposal_contract.applicable_market_regime: Observed only for 15m upward breakouts with EMA9 above EMA21 and positive depth-10 pressure; range, downward-breakout, and short-side behavior are unobserved.
proposal_contract.alternatives_considered: Immediate live addition, parameter retuning, fixed-horizon live exits, waiting without analysis, and continuing only SP500/SPCX collection. Immediate live or retuning is unsupported; SP500/SPCX collection continues independently.
proposal_contract.expected_upside: A larger causal sample and exact lifecycle replay can determine whether MU adds meaningful opportunity cadence and diversified return potential before risking capital.
proposal_contract.main_risks_and_failure_modes: Small sample, all-long selection, clustered and overlapping signals, winner concentration, unverified archive/live candle parity, missing funding and depth-constrained sizing, and fixed-horizon markouts that do not model stops or strategy exits.
proposal_contract.validation_completed: All seven entries and exits resolved against causal BBO rows; measured fee and latency friction applied; one- and two-largest-winner sensitivity calculated; authority remained none.
proposal_contract.validation_still_required: Exact archive/live candle row parity, a predeclared independent follow-on window with both sides represented, stop/exit lifecycle simulation, depth-sized fills, funding, stress friction, and untouched forward confirmation.
proposal_contract.success_metrics: At least 20 independent prospective paths with both directions represented; positive after-friction expectancy and ex-largest sensitivity; no unresolved source or lifecycle gaps; and a stop/exit replay that remains positive under stress without relying on one or two winners.
proposal_contract.failure_or_rollback_triggers: Negative after-friction or ex-largest results in the predeclared window, unresolved source parity, unacceptable depth/latency/funding costs, technical observer gaps, or concentration that disappears after removing the top two winners.

limitations: The current markout artifact is immutable, while the prospective observer continues appending future rows to separate source ledgers.

The artifact records exact point-in-time input byte counts and hashes, but the referenced append-only source paths are mutable; later reproduction must reconstruct those exact byte prefixes rather than hash the enlarged files.
Fixed-horizon BBO returns are diagnostic markouts, not realized strategy PnL.
The proposed sample count is a minimum investigation threshold, not a live-promotion gate or profitability guarantee.
No v51 strategy, asset, route, sizing, leverage, stop, target, execution, or deployment setting was changed.
